results.title: Voicenotes: AI note-taker that's truly intelligent | Product Hunt
results.content:
upload or transcription errors (2)

When creating a voice note there is often a failure for that note to upload to the cloud. The app has a link to "retry" and to "download" that note but these options NEVER work and often are just adding frustration to a moment when y you realize that all your notes are now GONE.   
  
The suggestion posted on their reddit thread says that it's a user error caused when the app is prematurely closed. However this is not the cause of all load failures. Often even with the app on well after the note is taken the app still fails to upload and transcribe and your notes are lost Forever.

Extremely disappointing.

I’ve been using Voicenotes as my go-to note-taking app. I upgraded to the Pro version just hours after trying it out. The app’s ability to effortlessly record thoughts and ideas, automatically transcribe them into searchable text, and provide AI-generated answers to questions about my notes makes it incredibly useful. I’ve used both the desktop and mobile versions. The iOS app, in particular, stands out as well-crafted and highly functional. I would recommend it to anyone looking to streamline their note-taking process!
